🚀 Master PySpark Functions in One Glance! 

If you're preparing for Data Engineering interviews or working with Spark at scale, this 1-page PySpark Functions Cheatsheet will save you hours!

🔥 Whether you're building ETL pipelines, transforming huge datasets, or just brushing up for an interview — knowing these core PySpark functions is a must:

🔹 Column Operations (col, lit, alias)
🔹 Aggregations (count, sum, avg, collect_list)
🔹 String Manipulations (concat, substr, regex)
🔹 Date & Time Logic (current_date, datediff, add_months)
🔹 Null Handling (when, coalesce, isNull)
🔹 Window Functions (row_number, rank, lag)
🔹 JSON & Struct Processing (from_json, struct)
🔹 Mathematical and Array Functions
…and more — all categorized and simplified in a visual format.

📌 Save it. Share it. Bookmark it for your next PySpark project!
✅ Especially useful for anyone targeting roles at EY, PwC, EXL, IBM, or any big data engineering 

Let’s connect and grow in the data space! 💡
